description: zn-gate: keep secret values out of tool calls, tool output and prompts. Every hook runs the pinned, verified zn-gate package through scripts/zn-launch.js.

hooks.command: sh -c '"$@"; rc=$?; case $rc in 127) r="launcher or node not found";; 126) r="launcher cannot be run";; *) exit $rc;; esac; echo "zn-gate could not start: $r; run zn-gate check" >&2; exit 2' zn-gate node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/zn-launch.js" hook claude-code
